en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Tenko for a while?
...Even though she's staring at the gym intensely.

I've been trying to send her thoughts
telepathically, but they're not reaching her...

I thought she'd be able to get them through
magic, but it seems like it's not working...

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time trying to
cheer up Tenko...
<CLT=cltMIND>Tenko and I grew a little closer today.
